verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is documented as open source with no forced API keys or paywalls. It runs locally as a Python library and ships an optimized Docker image with a FastAPI server for self-deployment, and a first-party self-hosting docs section exists. Community members independently describe it as an open-source library and point to Docker self-host setups. Missing for 10: in-depth self-hosting deployment detail in the pack (scaling, configuration, license terms beyond the 'Open Source' claim).

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service

citations.quote: Open Source: No forced API keys, no paywalls—everyone can access their data.
Dockerized Setup: Optimized Docker image with FastAPI server for easy deployment.
Crawl4AI is an amazing open-source library that solves many LLM-scraping headaches.
